assets.notes: Plain off-white plaster wall and pale honed stone floor, neutral daylight from camera-left, one white cup on the far half of the top. Room simplified after two window inpaints failed (an oak-framed panel, then a white void). Product pixels are the seed-16 structure output except the cup region; the beam is the render's geometry composited matte black (rgb ~27) with the gap under the top. Known residuals at 1:1 of the 2400 master: the closed top shows a soft veneer tone boundary near x~1080 (no line), the beam edges are 1-px anti-aliased stairs, the bottom 100 px of floor are generated (a straight slab joint sits at the seam), and the wall through the gap is a mirrored fill. Not a photograph: kind ai-visualisation, label it as a visualisation on the page.
